surplus.$comment: #203: solar surplus at home instead of on the grid (on grid, cooling). A step exporting under minExportW, or with the battery under socFullPct, does not count; setpoint = max(comfort - offsetK, heating minimum + 1), elderlyOffsetK in the safe room with an elderly person.

householdTip.$comment: #219, #365: loads the surplus tip may suggest, tried in order; one fits when the final plan exports at least meanW for durationH with the battery at or above surplus.socFullPct, and peakW plus the planned load stays within the inverter limit. Sourced (owner-approved, 2026-10-12): Beko 9 kg washing machine programme table https://documents.beko.com/WM/7178544700/en-GB/8748327591761291.html (eco 40-60 3 h 48 min, 0.535 kWh; cotton 40 C about 3 h 40 min, 1.10 kWh; quick 30 C 28 min, 0.25 kWh), consistent with the EU EPREL database https://eprel.ec.europa.eu; heater peak about 2 kW (typically 1.5-2.2 kW, vendor guides); cooking from the Endesa cooking page https://www.endesa.com/en/blogs/endesa-s-blog/light/cooking-using-less-energy-oven-ceramic-hob-microwave (oven about 1.5 kW, induction about 1.4 kW). Rounded for the tip: eco 3.75 h at 150 W mean (about 0.56 kWh), normal 3.5 h at 300 W (about 1.05 kWh), quick 0.5 h at 500 W (0.25 kWh), cooking 1 h at 1200 W with a 2.5 kW peak. The mean powers are the energy of the cycle spread over its duration.

outlook.$comment: Average load at each level for the ice cubes (assumption, to calibrate on the plant); Essential comes from the guard config (reserve.essentialLoadW).
